description_for_human: Look up reference exchange rates and convert example currency amounts.

functions.name: get_rates
functions.description: Latest or dated reference rates. Provider rates retain published digits on their own base. Returns rate records; if any provider fails, returns {rates,errors} preserving successes. Retry only failed providers.

functions.name: convert
functions.description: Convert money using a reference rate. Returns {amount,currency}, rounded to the target's minor units (8 significant figures for metals/crypto). Set details for the rate and effective date too; identity conversions have rate 1 and date null.

tools.name: get_rates
tools.title: Get exchange rates
tools.description: Latest or dated reference rates. Provider rates retain published digits on their own base. Returns rate records; if any provider fails, returns {rates,errors} preserving successes. Retry only failed providers.

base.description: Base currency or asset code. Default EUR.

date.description: Single day YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest rates.

quotes.description: Requested currency codes. Supply whenever known; omit only to request all.

provider.description: Provider or dataset keys, e.g. ['ECB','NBP.B']; omit for blended rates.

tools.name: convert
tools.title: Convert currency
tools.description: Convert money using a reference rate. Returns {amount,currency}, rounded to the target's minor units (8 significant figures for metals/crypto). Set details for the rate and effective date too; identity conversions have rate 1 and date null.

amount.description: Numeric amount in the source currency; normalize localized input first.

from.description: Source currency or asset code, e.g. USD, XAU or BTC.

date.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD for a past rate; omit for latest.

provider.description: Provider or dataset key, e.g. ECB or NBP.B; omit for blended rates.

details.description: Include rate, effective date and provider if selected. Default false.
